task_instance: Run the skill's core deliverable on its bundled analytical two-route branch model: invoke the CLI solver (scripts/mfa.py fit) on assets/branch-model.json with assets/branch-identifiable.json to recover the ~70/30 carbon-preserving vs carbon-swapping pathway split and produce a likelihood profile for the 'straight' flux, verifying the fitted flux estimates against the skill's stated expected values.
blocker_detail: The skill's central deliverable is produced only by executing a Python solver: the documented workflow installs a pinned toolchain into a virtual environment (uv venv + uv pip install mfapy from a Git revision, NumPy, SciPy, NLopt) and then runs scripts/mfa.py (check/simulate/fit), which drive mfapy's EMU forward simulator and SciPy constrained multistart optimization to estimate fluxes and compute likelihood profiles. This office-assistant runtime can only read/write/edit text files and fetch the web; it cannot run code, scripts or shell commands, cannot install packages, and the Bash tool is forbidden for this task. All required skill files are present (scripts/mfa.py, scripts/_mfa_model.py, scripts/_mfa_fit.py, assets/*.json, assets/requirements.txt, references/*.md), so nothing is missing from the skill itself; the sole barrier is the inability to execute the solver, and the rules forbid writing a replacement/stub for the bundled engine or fabricating the fluxes it would return. Therefore the actual flux-estimate deliverable cannot be produced or verified.
